customerSetup: The customer enters their own backend URL and auth token. PixlPush does not generate either.
PixlPush verifies them with GET <url>?limit=1 and Authorization: Bearer <token>.
The URL must be public HTTPS on port 443. Localhost, private IPs, credentials in the URL, and redirects are rejected.
The token is stored encrypted in IntegrationConnection.accessTokenEncrypted and is never returned.
currentFlow.syncDirection: Customer backend to PixlPush only. PixlPush pulls every 2 minutes through the existing integration worker and pushes nothing back.

rules: id must be 8 to 160 characters and unique per event. Repeated ids apply once.
time is required because SyncEntityVersion orders updates by occurredAt.
Billing events require product_id. segment_entered and segment_exited require segment.
One page holds at most 500 events and 5 MB.
One invalid event rejects its whole page and shows an error on the Webhook page.

schemaUse.IntegrationConnection: Customer URL, encrypted token, sync on/off, cursor, last sync, and errors. Provider is webhook.
schemaUse.SyncSource: One Webhook source per Project in production. Disconnect pauses it, a new connection reactivates it, and a deliberate pause stops pulling.
schemaUse.SyncMappingVersion: A default autoMap mapping is created on first pull.
schemaUse.SyncInboxRecord: Pulled events become durable encrypted records, deduplicated by sourceId and idempotencyKey.
schemaUse.SyncEntityVersion: Prevents older updates from overwriting newer ones.
schemaUse.UserEntitlement and ExternalSegment: Hold subscription states and external segment membership.
